title: Autocorrelation r(h)=|mu_n cap (mu_n+h)| IS the Fourier square of eta_b: F18 flatness <=> F2 sup-norm by Parseval, with the diagonal cap already proven
evidence: Two probes in scripts/probes/_407_conn/ at PROPER-subgroup prize primes (n=8,16,32,64; q ~ n^4, q=1 mod n, n<<sqrt(q)). probe_C021_autocorr_fourier_square.py confirms ALL THREE structural sub-claims to ~1e-13: (I) r_hat(b)=sum_h r(h)psi(-bh) == |eta_b|^2 EXACTLY for every tested frequency (n=8 q=4129 err 7e-15; n=16 q=65537 err 1e-13; n=32 q=1048609; n=64 q=16777601) -- so F18 (max_b r_hat(b) <= n*L) IS LITERALLY F2^2 (max_b|eta_b|^2 <= n*L); (II) the spatial-side diagonal cap r(h)<=r(0)=n holds on the UNSIGNED (1_G>=0) side at every case (max off-diagonal r(h)=2<=n) -- this is exactly the in-tree axiom-clean lemma autocorr_le_autocorr_zero (AutocorrelationMax.lean), Cauchy-Schwarz + translation invariance; (III) the SIGNED prize weight w(x)=1_G(x)*psi(bx) has rsig(h)=sum w(x)conj(w(x-h)) with min Re rsig(h) NEGATIVE off-diagonal at every n (-1.77,-1.0,-2.0,-2.0) -- so the nonneg hypothesis of autocorr_le_autocorr_zero genuinely FAILS for the signed case, while Parseval (rsig_hat(c)=|hat_w(c)|^2>=0) remains sign-blind. probe_C021_exact_and_truemax.py UPGRADES (I) to a rigorous EXACT integer check: the coefficient vectors of r_hat(b) and eta(b)conj(eta(b)) over the q-th-roots-of-unity basis are equal as integer multisets for several b (PROVEN-EXACT, q-,n-independent algebra). That probe ALSO computes the TRUE max over ALL b!=0: n=8 max|eta_b|=7.558 (|eta_b|^2=57.1) vs F18 target n*ln(q/n)=49.97; n=16 max=13.84 (191.5) vs 133.1 -- the F18 BOUND is VIOLATED at small q with this constant.
reduced_to: The affirmative duality is settled: F18 = F2-squared exactly (Parseval/orthogonality), and the spatial-side diagonal cap r(h)<=r(0)=n is the already-landed nonneg-weight lemma. The remaining open content reduces to exactly the FREQUENCY-side flatness of the SAME r: max_{b!=0}|eta_b|^2 <= n*log(p/n), i.e. the worst-case Gauss-sum-phase cancellation in the signed autocorrelation rsig(h)=sum_j tau_j conj(tau_{j+h}). That is the BGK/Paley sup-norm bound for thin mu_n (best PROVEN is n^{1-o(1)}, Ramanujan/Paley-conjecture open).
wall: W-BGK (the generalized-Paley-graph non-principal eigenvalue B=max_{b!=0}|eta_b|; B<=2sqrt(n) is the Paley Graph Conjecture, open; the identity exhibits the prize as precisely this Fourier sup-norm, it does not bound it).
honest_note: Strong PARTIAL, not a closure. (a) The PROVEN piece is genuine and exact: r_hat(b)=|eta_b|^2 is an algebraic identity (verified by integer coefficient-vector equality, q-/n-independent), and the spatial diagonal cap is an existing axiom-clean in-tree lemma -- this correctly identifies F18 as the literal Parseval dual of F2 and pinpoints why the dead-simple Cauchy-Schwarz lemma misses the prize (the signed weight is not nonnegative; probe III confirms Re rsig<0). (b) But the identity is a RESTATEMENT/relocation: it converts F18 into F2^2 without bounding either, so the prize content (the flatness bound itself) is untouched and welds directly to BGK. (c) #400-trap caveat honored and CONFIRMED dangerous: the F18 bound max_b|eta_b|^2 <= n*log(p/n) is itself VIOLATED at the small proper-subgroup primes I tested (n=8: 57.1>49.97; n=16: 191.5>133.1), so small-q flatness numerics would give a FALSE positive -- I did NOT claim the bound holds. Tested only the structural identity + sign + true-max placement, all at q~n^4; did not (and cannot at this scale) test the asymptotic BGK bound at the prize regime q~n^4-5, n=2^30. No new bound on B obtained.
